dedupe_keys.name: agricultural yield database flanders peilimpact project

description: This database records yields in tonnes per hectare of the main crops in Flanders under conventional farming, compiled for the PEILIMPACT project. The Zenodo record says it covers maize, winter wheat, sugar beet, potato and grass, with planting and harvest dates and grass mowing times where available, collected from ILVO research departments and other Flemish public and private institutions. Version 2 was published in January 2023 by researchers at the Flanders Research Institute for Agriculture, Fisheries and Food and KU Leuven under the CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 licence, free for non-commercial use, as two CSV files and a description document of under 1 MB. Coverage is Flanders, Belgium. Caveats: the years and sites are not stated on the page read, and the data are trial and farm records, not a census. For simulation it gives observed yields and crop calendars to calibrate crop models of groundwater and drought impacts. Related catalogue records include the CY-Bench crop yield benchmark and the harmonized IACS inventory.
name: Agricultural yield database Flanders (PEILIMPACT project)
provider: Flanders Research Institute for Agriculture, Fisheries and Food (ILVO) and KU Leuven authors, via Zenodo
